Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?

Sent · Just now

SweetBot · AI

SweetBot · AI says:

Yes, there are several ways to speed up memory foam expansion if you need it sooner:

Warm the room to at least 68°F (20°C) so the foam softens and expands faster.
Lay the mattress flat, ideally on the floor, and give it up to 72 hours.
Gently roll or move around on it for 10–30 minutes to loosen the foam.
Sleep on it for a few nights; your body heat and weight can further encourage full expansion.

Please don’t worry if it takes longer than expected—factors like low temperature, higher density, or staying boxed for a long time can all slow expansion, but the foam can still reach its proper shape over time.
